question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin add built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, and if so should it default on or require explicit opt-in?
rationale: The capability is source-verifiably missing and feasible within the plugin, but it changes retrieval semantics, config/defaults, persistent index lifecycle, and overlaps with external advanced-memory plugin directions.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid retrieval with explicit config, FTS setup, fallback policy, docs, and tests while keeping the behavior inside the plugin boundary.

options.title: Defer advanced retrieval externally
options.body: Keep official memory-lancedb vector-only and point advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank users to an external plugin or ClawHub package.

options.title: Keep vector-only by design
options.body: Close the direction after documenting that memory-core and QMD own hybrid retrieval while memory-lancedb remains a vector backend.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid retrieval with explicit config, FTS setup, fallback policy, docs, and tests while keeping the behavior inside the plugin boundary.
